answer: An operator running 90 keys therefore pays for 90 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the lagoon quota and the copper admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 3 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. Since the throttle counters live in the sable ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
